FCRT_model.assignment: each token has at most one owner; multiple tokens and residual sinks may share one owner
FCRT_model.charging: sinks consumed by a block are absent from residual packets, so original sink capacity is charged once
FCRT_model.optimizer: all pairwise-disjoint block families, then exact eligibility-constrained capped-product DP
FCRT_model.surplus_token: each selected saturated (S,T) creates the indivisible factor rad(T)/core(S)
FCRT_model.target_delivery: the factor delivered to p is min(rad(T)/core(S), rad(U)); the optimizer chooses the largest eligible exact U-cap and records U
FCRT_model.token_eligibility: a token may serve one remaining p only if some nonempty proper U subset T has p^e | a_U+b_U

claim_discipline.FCRT_status: FCRT is evaluated as a finite candidate successor only; no uniform theorem is asserted.
claim_discipline.SCRT_0_status: No bounded no-hit, frequency, or growing finite pattern proves or refutes the quantified gate.
claim_discipline.current_conclusion: This computation supplies no such unbounded family.
claim_discipline.finite_scope: Every exhaustive or structured result is finite evidence only.
claim_discipline.refutation_threshold: Only a complete-premise family with B_SCRT - epsilon*log(rad(abc)) unbounded for some fixed epsilon>0 refutes SCRT-0.
claim_discipline.standard_abc: not proved or disproved by this computation

model.arithmetic: all feasibility and optimizer comparisons exact over integers/Fraction
model.block_rule: chosen source masks and sink masks are separately pairwise disjoint
model.compatibility: product(p^v_p(c), p in S) divides a_T+b_T
model.exclusive_rule: each residual sink is unused or assigned to exactly one residual source
model.saturation: product(source capacities in S) <= product(q, q in T)
